_readme: Prices from stores that are NOT Woolworths or Coles, for the handful of items
where a third retailer is worth watching. Keyed by list_item, exactly as it
appears in latest.json. Absent key = the row looks and behaves like any other.
name    product name AS SOLD there - the size in it drives the unit price,
same as everywhere else in this app
packs   OPTIONAL, count for items sold by the piece (nappies): unit price
checked ISO date the price was last confirmed
Hand-maintained for now. Both retailers serve an empty shell to an automated
browser (Priceline runs a Cloudflare JS challenge, Chemist Warehouse renders
client-side), so neither is scrapeable the way Woolworths and Coles are - a
per-store adapter using the scraper's persistent Chrome profile is the
remaining piece. This file is the contract that adapter will fill.
